theDiagnosisThisLaneBuiltOn.oneCorrectionToIt: FIX14 placed the page-13 name write at (51.47, 300.17) 'on the PROOF OF NOTICE Petitioner line'. The rectangle and the page are right; the line is not. Read against the page's own printed words, that widget sits in the DISTRIBUTION block -- printed text to its left is the block's tick square, to its right 'Bureau of Motor Vehicles', and directly beneath it the word 'Petitioner'. The rendered canonical fixture confirms it: page 13 prints 'Jordan Avery Reyes' above 'Petitioner' in the distribution column, and '118 Maple Street' in the address lines beneath it, both inside the distribution list rather than on the PROOF OF NOTICE 'Petitioner: ____' line, which stays blank. The guide now names the distribution list.

whatWasWrong.class: The guide described a different packet from the one its own build delivered. Every sentence below was measured false against the delivered bytes, and each occurred exactly once in each of the two builders because the prose had been copy-pasted rather than shared.
theFiveDuplicatedFalseSentences: Of its fifteen pages, only the Appearance on pages 1-2 carries form boxes for the participant's own details.

The petition's caption, its "Comes now the Petitioner ______" line and its paragraph 1 full-name blank carry no form boxes at all; nor does the proposed order's caption; nor does the Confidential Information Form's cause number or name.
So this packet filled in, on the Appearance only: ...
Copy the caption across every document. ... The petition, Form ACR, the Confidential Information Form and the proposed order all carry the same caption and none of them has boxes for it.
This family writes nothing below the proposed order's caption anywhere ...
whatWasWrong.whatTheBytesSay: cap-PetitionerFullName is ONE field with 14 widgets on pages 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9 and 13. cap-COUNTY is ONE field with 8 widgets on pages 1, 3, 7 and 9 -- twice per caption, once after 'IN THE' and once after 'COUNTY OF'. Address is ONE field with 2 widgets on pages 1 and 13. DD-cap-CourtType is ONE field with 4 widgets on pages 1, 3, 7 and 9. Five written values print in 26 places. The caption is therefore already printed on the petition, Form ACR, the Confidential Information Form and the proposed order, and following 'copy the caption across every document' meant hand-writing over printed text on four filed documents.
whatWasWrong.whichBlanksTheNameActuallyReaches: Read from the pinned source with pdftotext -bbox against each widget's own rectangle, and confirmed in the rendered canonical fixture page by page: page 1 caption and Appearance paragraph 1; page 3 caption, the petition's 'Comes now the Petitioner' line and its paragraph 1 full-name blank; page 5 the Printed Name line beneath the signature; page 7 the Form ACR caption and two places in its notice text; page 8 the Confidential Information Form's 'PETITIONER'S NAME' line; page 9 the order's caption, its opening 'Petitioner, ____' line and its FINDINGS paragraph 1; page 13 the distribution list.
whatWasWrong.theOnlyTrueHalfOfTheClaim: The caption's CAUSE NO. line genuinely has no box -- there is no cap-CauseNumber field anywhere in the 68-field bundle, and page 8's 'XP CAUSE NUMBER' line has none either. That is now stated on its own, as the one caption item the participant must write into all five documents by hand.
whatWasWrong.ins1B: All four delivered fixtures are fully flattened: 0 AcroForm fields and 0 widget annotations on every one of the 15 + 4 pages, read with pdf-lib from the fixture bytes. The guide nonetheless directed the participant to open a dropdown and tick boxes. Every field identifier it names is now labelled as the Coalition's name for that blank on the Coalition's own published fillable form, and the delivery is described as what it is: flattened, to be printed and completed in pen.
whatWasWrong.line78: 'Put the full number nowhere else.' was inaccurate for a fillable delivery and is corrected rather than deleted. The bundle asks for the whole Social Security number twice -- the Confidential Information Form on page 8 and the proposed order's findings paragraph 2 on page 9 -- and both pages carry NOT FOR PUBLIC RECORD on their own printed faces. The guide now says so, says that pages 1 to 7 are the public ones, and says that the only Social Security digits reaching a public page are the last four in the petition's paragraph 2.

whatWasNotChanged.note: The defect was in what the guide said about what the packet writes, not in what it writes. No field map, no binding decision, no refusal and no rendered value was touched. Every fixture in both families is byte-identical after the repair.
whatWasNotChanged.onePlacementWorthAsecondOpinionButNotAde: cap-PetitionerFullName and Address reach the proposed order's page-13 distribution list, so the participant's name and street address are printed inside the order. This lane does not fold that into the repair. It reads as correct: the distribution list is the list of who the clerk sends the signed order to, page 13 is stamped NOT FOR PUBLIC RECORD on its own face, and the petitioner is one of the parties served. It is recorded here so counsel can disagree with it on the record rather than discover it.

theRepair.whyOneModuleRatherThanTwoEdits: The two builders are standalone -- scripts/build-census-v1-in_arrest_no_charges-set.mjs and scripts/build-census-v1-in_section1_petition-set.mjs -- and about 96% identical. The defective prose was not shared code; it was copy-pasted once into each, which is why two independent verifiers found the same defect in the same jurisdiction. Fixing one paragraph twice would have left the next copy-paste free to fork them again. The guide body now exists once and both builders import it. Only four route-specific values stay in the builders: ROUTE_LABEL, ROUTE_ELIGIBILITY, ROUTE_KEYS/ROUTE_STATUTES and SELF_HELP_TAIL. After the repair the two rendered guides differ in exactly those four places and nowhere else.
theRepair.generatedNotHandWritten: The paragraphs that state where values land are rendered from the build's own records rather than typed beside them. measureDelivery() reads field-census.census-v1.json for widget counts and page bindings, production-field-map.json for which fields are written, and reports/participant-name-placement.json for the 14 measured name placements, and the guide's tables and sentences are generated from that object. A future change to the field map moves the guide with it.
theRepair.invariant: assertRepairInvariants() -- the shape the Alabama host repair installed in scripts/build-census-v1-al-diversion-set.mjs -- runs at the end of every build of either family, after every artifact is written, and re-reads the finished artifacts including the fixture bytes.
whatTheInvariantRefuses: any of eleven retired sentences reappearing in the guide, including all five duplicated false ones
a widget count or page list in the guide that does not match the field census
a name-placement count that does not match reports/participant-name-placement.json, or any placement outside the allowlist
a guide that no longer names what the packet prints in the order's page-13 distribution list
a dropdown or tick-box instruction while the fixtures carry zero AcroForm fields, and a fixture that regains fillable widgets while the guide still calls the delivery flattened
PetFullSSN reaching any of the public pages 1 to 7
any shared field first collected on a non-public page and also printed on a public one
a caption cause-number box appearing in a future source revision while the guide still tells the participant to write it in by hand
theRepair.theInvariantWasTested: Eleven tamper cases were run against a clean build -- reintroducing each retired sentence, altering a widget count, altering the name-placement count, removing the page-13 paragraph, re-adding a dropdown and a tick instruction, removing the flattened-delivery heading and removing the public-pages sentence. The clean guide passed and all eleven mutations were refused with the specific message naming what had drifted.

counterEvidenceDisclaimer: verify-packet-completeness.mjs returns PASS_COMPLETE with all nine counters at zero for both families BEFORE and AFTER this repair. Nine zeros are the starting condition here, not this lane's evidence. No completeness counter reaches a guide-versus-bytes correspondence defect -- the counters count blanks, not sentences -- which is exactly why this survived a build, two verifiers and a PASS_COMPLETE. The evidence is the correspondence between the guide's sentences and the delivered pages, set out above and now enforced by assertRepairInvariants().

theThirteenOtherSharedFieldsThatStraddle.questionAsked: Does any of them create a real disclosure problem the way the SSN did not?
theThirteenOtherSharedFieldsThatStraddle.answer: NO. Not one of the thirteen. The direction of travel is the whole answer, and on all thirteen it runs the protective way.
theThirteenOtherSharedFieldsThatStraddle.howPagesWereClassified: From the pages' own printed faces in the delivered canonical fixture, not from the form's name: pages 8, 9, 12, 13 and 14 carry 'NOT FOR PUBLIC RECORD' as a header and 'NOT PUBLIC RECORD' as a footer; pages 1 to 7 carry neither; pages 10, 11 and 15 are placeholder and instruction leaves.
theThirteenOtherSharedFieldsThatStraddle.theTest: A shared field is a disclosure problem only if the form collects it somewhere non-public and then reprints it somewhere public. The reverse -- a fact a public filing already asks for, copied into the non-public order -- moves nothing onto the record that was not already going there. Measured as min(publicPages) < min(nonPublicPages) for every straddling field.
theThirteenOtherSharedFieldsThatStraddle.result: All thirteen are public-first. Every one of them is a fact the Appearance, the petition, Form ACR or the petition's page-5 agency list already puts on the public record by the form's own design, and the second copy lands inside the proposed order, which the Coalition designates non-public in full. None is collected only on a non-public page.

theThirteenOtherSharedFieldsThatStraddle.whatWouldChangeThisAnswer: A future source revision that moved any of these thirteen so it is first collected on a non-public page. assertRepairInvariants() now fails the build if that happens, so it cannot arrive silently.
